summary: The registrant, Korea Electric Power Corp (KEPCO), files a Form 6-K reporting routine appointments of six non-standing directors by the Ministry of Finance and Economy, effective May 8, 2026, for a two-year term. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is disclosed. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer update on board composition. There are no deal terms, premium, or financial consideration. As a monthly report of a routine governance change, this does not constitute a special situation meriting classification.
